render_notes: One persistent three.js/WebGL2 scene; DOM/CSS owns archival UI. PHYSICS vs DISPLAY space (log-compressed), always labeled 'SCHEMATIC — NOT TO SCALE'. Desktop: up to 5,000 ghost trajectories; mobile: 500–1,000; static/SVG fallbacks; reduced-motion support. Truth grammar: solid=observed / dashed=predicted / dotted=hypothetical / double-line=disputed.
